card.name: Second half of split English words
card.fires_on: The closing piece of an English word that was split in two, such as re|printed, foot|prints, bottom|line or Subsid|ies. It appears in general web text, not label text.

modes.label: Reprinted notices
modes.description: The word printed after re in credit lines saying a story is reprinted from a source.
modes.example: The above story is re<<printed>> from materials provided by American College of Physicians

modes.label: Compound word endings
modes.description: The second half of a compound or a split word, such as line or prints.
modes.example: The bottom<< line>> for buying produce: Educate yourself.
